preconditions.description: The length of the input word s is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The input word s consists of uppercase and lowercase Latin letters only.

postconditions.expression: all(c.islower() if len([c for c in s if c.islower()]) >= len([c for c in s if c.isupper()]) else c.isupper() for c in s)
postconditions.description: If the word s has strictly more lowercase letters, the output word is in lowercase. Otherwise, the output word is in uppercase.
